alt: 校園機器人競賽中，一台機器人順利抵達終點，其他作品仍停在障礙前。
scene_prompt: 無出其右 means nobody can surpass someone in a particular skill. At a modern school robotics fair, one child's carefully designed small robot completes a simple obstacle course with impressive precision while other students' robots remain stopped at earlier obstacles; judges and classmates admire the successful design. Make superior achievement clear through the robot reaching the finish marker first, without text, numbers or trophy lettering. Friendly, noncompetitive tone. Robots have plausible wheels, balanced chassis, joints and sensors; children natural with two arms and legs, hands safely away from moving mechanisms; table and course grounded, perspective sensible.
